collector_node_deleted_revoked.name: collector_node_deleted_revoked
collector_node_deleted_revoked.value: "ingestion"."collector_node"."deleted_at" IS NULL OR "ingestion"."collector_node"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL

enrollment_key_adapter.name: enrollment_key_adapter
enrollment_key_adapter.value: "ingestion"."enrollment_key"."adapter" IN ('standard', 'linux') AND "ingestion"."enrollment_key"."allowed_local_kinds" <@ ARRAY[2,3,4,6,8]::integer[] AND cardinality("ingestion"."enrollment_key"."allowed_local_kinds") <= 5 AND ("ingestion"."enrollment_key"."adapter" <> 'standard' OR cardinality("ingestion"."enrollment_key"."allowed_local_kinds") = 0)

create_receipt_operation_scope.name: create_receipt_operation_scope
create_receipt_operation_scope.value: ("app"."create_receipt"."operation" = 'create-project' AND "app"."create_receipt"."project_id" IS NULL) OR ("app"."create_receipt"."operation" = 'create-execution' AND "app"."create_receipt"."project_id" IS NOT NULL)

execution_window.name: execution_window
execution_window.value: "app"."execution"."started_at" >= timestamptz '1970-01-01' AND "app"."execution"."ended_at" <= timestamptz '2101-01-01' AND "app"."execution"."ended_at" > "app"."execution"."started_at" AND "app"."execution"."ended_at" <= "app"."execution"."started_at" + interval '7 days'

project_tags_bounded.name: project_tags_bounded
project_tags_bounded.value: cardinality("app"."project"."tags") <= 20 AND array_position("app"."project"."tags", NULL) IS NULL
